objective: Make real website identification possible by moving from contract-only website evidence to a no-write URL-in, structured-evidence-out resolver adapter.
goal: Accept a consultant-entered URL, normalize it, fetch the homepage and discovered secondary pages, extract website evidence, and return idb.website-evidence.v1 with honest failure states.

roles.name: Website Intelligence Agent
roles.owns: Extraction logic for title, meta description, H1/H2, navigation, product terms, industry language, service/location clues, and commerce/manufacturing/distribution signals.

roles.name: Resolver Service Architect
roles.owns: No-write endpoint/service shape, POST request/response contract, and adapter boundary.

roles.name: Security Guard
roles.owns: URL scheme rejection, tracking query cleanup, blocked status handling, timeout handling, no write authority, and no SuiteScript invocation.

roles.name: Validation And Evidence Agent
roles.owns: Resolver harness, live-adapter samples, failure-state samples, trace sample, and validator gates.

fetchStrategy: Normalize URL and reject unsupported schemes.
Discover up to three same-site secondary product/category/service pages from navigation anchors.
Extract structured evidence from fetched HTML.
Return confidence and failureState without invoking writes.
